description: Election Commission - M. Vasantharaj was elected as the member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process, including the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a seat that became vacant. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of election results for local authorities.
